patterns.note: Sections are often presented in a split-screen layout, pairing large, full-bleed editorial photography with product imagery or minimal text blocks.
The brand name 'ALIPO' is used as an oversized, semi-transparent background element, creating a strong, almost architectural brand presence across multiple sections.
A predominantly monochrome palette of whites, greys, and blacks is used for backgrounds and text, with product colors (like deep red, navy, olive) providing the main accents.
The oversized 'ALIPO' brand logo in the background scrolls at a slower rate than the foreground content, creating a subtle parallax effect that keeps the brand visible throughout the page.
The main navigation bar at the top of the page remains sticky as the user scrolls down, ensuring constant access to key links.
Product display sections feature individual items isolated on a plain, light background, presented in a clean grid or row.

technique_notes: To achieve the distinctive brand presence, implement a large, semi-transparent text element (the brand name) as a fixed or slow-scrolling background layer, allowing foreground content to scroll over it, creating a parallax effect. Hero images also employ a subtle parallax, moving slightly slower than the scroll. The main navigation bar should be set to stick to the top of the viewport after the initial scroll depth.

Design sections using a flexible grid system that allows for full-bleed imagery on one side and content (text or product images) on the other, adapting to different screen sizes while maintaining visual balance.
Utilize a minimalist approach for product displays, isolating items on clean, neutral backgrounds to emphasize the product's form and color.

design_tokens.type_scale: Body text is small and understated, while the brand logo acts as an extremely oversized, bold, uppercase display element.
design_tokens.spacing: airy — particularly in hero sections and between major content blocks, with product grids being more balanced.

standout: The most distinctive feature is the pervasive use of the oversized, semi-transparent brand name 'ALIPO' as a background element that scrolls with a parallax effect. This creates a powerful, ever-present brand identity that feels integrated into the page's structure rather than just a logo at the top.
